description: Test a WebSocket endpoint (ws:// or wss://): attempts the handshake, reports success/failure, time-to-open in ms, and close code/reason. Useful for verifying a WebSocket server is reachable and completes its upgrade handshake before you wire real traffic to it.

url.description: WebSocket URL to test, e.g. wss://example.com/socket

name: websocket_endpoint_check
